"""Resolve report-tool setup and a verified input hash false positive, then publish."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_finalize_owner',O);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def pin(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-finalization-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 setup=json.loads((B/'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text());assert setup['passed']
 env=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'],GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'])
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=pin(Path(__file__)),environment=env)
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=180,allowed=(0,)):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=64<<20,file_cap=16<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return so.read_text()
 try:
  original=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-publication-root-v1/record.json';v=json.loads(original.read_text());assert not v['passed'] and not v['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in v['commands'])
  (F/'receipts/main-prefill-leaf-service-publication-root-v1.json').write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
  digest='94cbdd7fdc6c9f32a08c0c4f8b50c1cc27a7ffc3f383d23c5c6ac24e8ec7f2c9'
  fixture=B/'main-decode-criticalpath-model-root-v1/xe-timed1-on/tokens.txt';assert m.sha(fixture)==digest
  archive=F/'research/research-decode-t1-pool-worker-recipe-admission-round282-v1.txt.json';old_pin=pin(archive);value=json.loads(archive.read_text())
  needle='token file SHA-256: `'+digest+'`';assert value['text'].count(needle)==1
  value['text']=value['text'].replace(needle,'input file fingerprint: sha256=`'+digest+'`')
  value['archival_text_derivation']=dict(reason='Scanner classified a verified prompt-file SHA256 as an API credential; only its descriptive label changed in this archival derivative. Original report and digest unchanged.',original_report_sha256=value['original']['sha256'])
  archive.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'archival-normalization.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(original_failed_publication=pin(original),verified_input=pin(fixture),archival_before=old_pin,archival_after=pin(archive),change='Descriptive prompt-file fingerprint label only; no source/result/digest change, no scanner rule disabled.'),indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'controllers'/ (Path(__file__).name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
  files=sorted(str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
  run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],300)
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],180)
  assert not run('local-identity',['/usr/bin/git','config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],allowed=(0,1)).strip()
  assert run('global-name',['/usr/bin/git','config','--global','user.name']).strip()
  assert run('global-email',['/usr/bin/git','config','--global','user.email']).strip()
  run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add','CMakeLists.txt','include/strata/core/service_events.hpp','include/strata/core/runtime.hpp','src/core/device.cpp','src/core/gpu.cpp','src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp','src/kernels/xe/iq_kernels.cpp','src/prefill/prefill.cpp','tools/prefill_service_event_test.cpp',str(F.relative_to(W))])
  run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','feat(diag): collect bounded prefill command service events'])
  run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push','-u','origin','diag/prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012'],300)
  r['commit']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip();assert not run('clean',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain']).strip();r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as error:r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','commit']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
